title: Just Juice Bar Range Vanilla Rhubarb Saltfill Shortfill 40ml E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Vanilla Rhubarb Saltfill offers a distinctive blend of smooth and sharp flavours. Creamy Vanilla forms a mellow backdrop, while tangy Rhubarb cuts through with its signature bite. Each Saltfill e-liquid comes in a 60ml bottle containing 40ml of concentrated flavour, leaving space for up to two 10ml nicotine shots. With a 60PG/40VG ratio, these e-liquids are designed to deliver sharp flavour with a tactile throat hit, making them an excellent choice for pod kits and starter devices. Just Juice Saltfills use double-concentrated flavouring for a bold and consistent taste experience, letting you enjoy your favourite profiles just the way you like them. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
